newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - JAN 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - JAN 30.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

Today Toyota backtracked on the controversial statement it made yesterday warning that future investment was threatened if Britain stayed out of European monetary union. The President of Toyota Hirosi Okuda insisted that Toyota's investment strategy in Britain had "not changed at all.'
SEARCH FOR SEARS CHIEF TURNS TO OZ
Headhunters have made approaches as far afield as Australia in an attempt to find a new chief executive for troubled retail group Sears.
In a scheme of complex capital restructuring that could cost Yorkshire Water 147 million stg, the company would give thousands of small investors a one-off payment of 140 stg each.
Standard Life is set to cut the payouts it makes to endowment and policyholders this year.
DIAGONAL GETS A 40 MILLION STG ANGLE ON THE MARKET
In six weeks' time former managing director of PE, Mark Samuels, is bringing software company Diagonal to the market.
